name: Night Switch
niche: bedtime audio track and 14-night habit guide for winding down
summary: An 11-minute bedtime audio track paired with a 14-night habit guide meant to help listeners wind down before sleep; explicitly not a medical treatment.

name: FocusFix: The Emotional Clarity Kit
niche: downloadable kit for identifying emotional triggers behind lost focus
summary: A 14-module downloadable kit that helps people name the emotion behind a lost work session and use short resets and a start ritual to regain focus.
best_for: people who lose work time to distraction and want a structured, non-motivation-dependent reset method
